sections.name: File setup, guidanceFor
sections.title: Test helper for guidance
sections.what: Brings in the test tools and the document, guidance and verification services, then defines a helper that builds guidance for a case from its verification results and documents.
sections.why: Saves each test from repeating the same setup steps.
sections.watch_out: The helper assumes verification always returns a result for the case.

sections.name: deterministic next-action guidance
sections.title: Checks for next-action guidance behavior
sections.what: Runs checks on the guidance list for the hero case and the control case. It confirms that the hero area and family items come first with their source documents, that issues sort before no-action items, that the control case shows no urgent review items, that repeated runs give the same result, and that the Hindi text keeps the same meaning as the English.
sections.why: Likely reason: guidance is what citizens read, so these checks stop the order and urgency from changing without notice.
sections.watch_out: The Hindi check looks for one specific Hindi word in the caution text, so rewording that text breaks the test even when the meaning is right.

summary: Provides a test helper that builds guidance for a case by running verification and listing its documents. The packet shows only this helper, so the tests that use it could not be described.
purpose: Makes it simple for the guidance tests to get guidance for a case with real inputs.
why: Likely reason: guidance depends on verification results and documents, so the helper gathers both in one place.
how: The helper runs verification for a case, asserts that a result exists, lists the case's documents, and passes both to the guidance builder.
outputs: The guidance result for that case.
risks: The helper uses a non-null assertion, so if verification returns nothing it fails with a less clear message.
debug: If guidance tests fail before any check runs, check the verification run and the document list for that case.
